Name: Brain criticality predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization (Fusca, Siebenhuehner, Wang et al., 2023): SEEG/MEG PLV and DFA (derivative)

GeneratedBy.Name: Authors' analysis pipeline (Fuscà et al., 2023, Nat Commun 14:4736, Methods)
GeneratedBy.Description: 10-min eyes-closed resting-state SEEG from 68 drug-resistant focal epilepsy patients (Niguarda Ca' Granda Hospital, Milan; monopolar, 8-15 contacts per shaft); rejection of 500-ms windows with epileptic artifacts; closest-white-matter referencing; FIR broadband filtering (cutoff 440 Hz) and 50 Hz notch filters; 24 Morlet wavelets (m=5), 2-225 Hz; complex phase-locking value (PLV) between all contact pairs and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) exponents per contact; epileptogenic-zone (EZ) contact masks from clinical review. MEG: 192 eyes-open resting-state sessions of 52 healthy subjects, source-reconstructed to the 400-parcel Schaefer atlas, wPLI and DFA. Simulations: hierarchical Kuramoto models. Code: https://github.com/palvalab/DFA_Synch/
